get.description: This API lists a particular number of events, based on the limit specified.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Secondary information related to the events. Possible values: contacts, assignee, tickets, teams, integInfo

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time for completing the event. Values allowed are Overdue, Tomorrow, CurrentWeek, CurrentMonth and Today.You can pass multiple values by separating them with commas.

parameters.name: departmentIds
parameters.description: Departments from which the events need to be queried

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: Key that filters tickets by assignee. Values allowed are any valid assignee ID or multiple assignee IDs separated by commas.

parameters.name: viewId
parameters.description: ID of the view to apply while fetching the resources

parameters.name: isCompleted
parameters.description: Key that denotes whether the event is completed or not

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: ID of the department from which the event count must be fetched

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of events to list

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the events must be listed

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Key that returns the values of mentioned fields (both pre-defined and custom) in your portal. All field types except multi-text are supported. Standard, non-editable fields are supported too. These fields include:  photoURL, webUrl. Maximum of 30 fields is supported as comma separated values.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: To fetch the events based on the filters specified in the criteria JSON, which includes the field and its conditions.

parameters.name: filterId
parameters.description: ID of the SavedFilter to filter the records

get.description: This API lists a particular number of events associated with a ticket, based on the limit specified.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Allowed values are : contacts, assignee,tickets,teams,integInfo.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of events to list

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number, starting from which the events must be listed

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort by a specific attribute: startTime or createdTime.The default sorting order is ascending. A - prefix denotes descending order of sorting.

parameters.description: Key that denotes whether to fetch spam events or not
